item.title: Governing multi-system innovation: A policy mix on its emergence, co-evolution, and diffusion
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how governments develop and coordinate multiple policy instruments to address complex innovation challenges that span different technological and sectoral systems. The focus is on understanding how integrated policy approaches emerge, evolve together over time, and spread across different contexts and regions.

Appel publié par Research Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Multi-system innovation
  • Policy mix
  • Emergence of policy mix
  • Co-evolution of policy instruments
  • Diffusion of policy mechanisms
